headline: Completed construction of bridge over Sabarmati river for Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project; know its length?
summary: Construction of a bridge over the Sabarmati river in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, has been completed for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project. Of 25 river bridges on the 508-kilometre line, 18 are now complete.
why: The Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail line is India's first bullet train project, a large state-backed infrastructure investment executed by the National High Speed Rail Corporation.
